method: Generated body poses sampled at hard cell centres, quantized to approved palette without iris/eye white, approved head pasted, placed at provided pivots, binary-alpha nearest-neighbor 8x export.
known_limits: Body poses are generated approximations of supplied motion, not exact native animation reconstructions.
R dash and final two death frames use generated heads as allowed by the brief.
Arms, wing attachment, collar spacing and run-cycle smoothness require visual/in-game review; mechanical checks do not prove these semantics.
No skill effects, game-data edits or mod installation were performed.
visual_review: Overview and eight frame contact sheets inspected; run hip attachment corrected and rechecked. Gameplay fidelity remains an approximation and has not been tested in game.
